title: Obstructed subhomogeneous-bundle extensions and embeddings
summary: We address a number of problems concerning the (im)possibility of either extending locally trivial subbundles of possibly singular Banach/$C^*$ bundles globally, embedding subhomogeneous bundles into homogeneous ones, or recovering locally trivial compact-Lie-group-equivariant Banach or $C^*$ bundles as pullbacks along equivariant maps to compact spaces.
